corrections.reason: The 5th-order ring at the bottom of ቴ in 'ማቴዎስ' (Abba Matthew) is visible on the image and was misread as 3rd-order ቲ.
Classical Ge'ez temporal conjunction 'ወሶበ' (and when) is printed with 7th-order ሶ (cf. Col 2 L16), misread as 1st-order ሰ.
In the Ge'ez phrase 'ኢይመውዖ ወኢይሄይሎ' (does not conquer/overcome him), the printed glyphs on line 22 are clearly 'ኢይመው-' (from መውዐ), which Stage 1 transposed as 'ኢመይው-'.
Canonical Ge'ez Gospel of John 1:9 perfect relative verb 'ዘመጽአ ውስተ ዓለም' is printed with 1st-order አ (shorter right leg), misread as 6th-order እ.
